headline: Philippines Treasury Raises $470 Million From Reissued 2031 T-Bond Auction
summary: The Philippine Bureau of the Treasury fully awarded its 30 billion pesos ($470.15 million) offer of reissued 2031 Treasury bonds at an average yield of 7.623%. Total bids reached 71.66 billion pesos.
why: The Philippine Bureau of the Treasury auctions sovereign bonds to finance public infrastructure and government deficit requirements.

impacts.name: Philippine 2031 T-Bond Yield
impacts.why: Auction pricing establishes benchmark borrowing costs for Philippine public debt.
